text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit dammit dammit! Everyone get out of 
my way, nodda! Don't you dare run in front 
of Windy-chan!!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuuugh! I'm gonna bite that guy—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (—It's no good!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (I promised not to bite anymore—!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—Haa! Haa! Th-That was close, I must 
say...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~, Shinko Windy...! You really ran 
hard today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running is far better than it was 
during her debut race. The fruits of her 
training are clearly showing.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe♪ Right? Right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan can do anything if she puts 
her mind to it...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean... the other girls didn't run that 
great. Kinda felt like they were all 
running scared, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it. Talk about a stroke of good 
luck...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If they're worried about getting bitten, 
the other girls are gonna tense up too, 
y'know. Ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Wha—! What did you saaaay... !?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
True that... Wait, weren't you trying to 
bite them again just now?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Kh! Th-Th-That's not...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But I didn't stumble over my words, see?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (*roar of laughter* Wahahaha—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy was running well. However, 
what the spectators were focusing on 
was...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to see Windy-san bite 
someone~! I mean, I know she shouldn't, 
but still...

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
You really wanted them to do something 
funny, didn't ya! That's what makes 'em so 
lovable, right? Ahaha!
choice_data_list: (No one can see my true ability at all...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After causing an incident like that, it 
was inevitable she'd be viewed with 
prejudice, which in turn affected her 
evaluations. Even so, she was undeniably 
growing.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Is that so~? The audience... didn't seem 
to think so. They were cackling and 
laughing so loudly!"
choice_data_list:
You really showed the results of your 
training.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Windy-chan didn't bite, and even when 
I lost focus, I got it back right away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Next time... I'll make them realize I'm 
not a 'biter' anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And then, I'll make every last one of 'em 
eat their words!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...To overturn the public's perception, 
perhaps I need to demonstrate my true 
ability on an even bigger stage."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a high-grade race, the other 
competitors are undoubtedly top-tier... If 
I win there, no one can call it a fluke.
choice_data_list: Let's take a leap and enter a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: GⅠ……！

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"If I win there, everyone will think 
'Windy-chan is amazing,' right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Schedule-wise, the Japan Dirt Derby looks 
good. I told her we should make that our 
next goal.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "All right! I'm going out there!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Win there, and wipe away annoying 'bad 
reputations' like 'coward' or 
'troublemaker'!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"And then, and then, I'm gonna give them 
an even cooler "notorious name"!!"
